questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

6 : 252 : : 5 : ?
questions.solution:
6 × 6 × 7 = 252

Similarly,

5 × 5 × 6 = 150

Hence, **150 is related to 5 the same way 252 is related to 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

6² + 6³ = 36 + 216 = 252

Similarly,

5² + 5³ = 25 + 125 = **150**

questions.question:
Find the number of rectangles in the given figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d04487a9ebd9442b6f0fb1109f2a676d76d4ec8981fed12eb4baf2507e52f2d.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

**__Rectangle__:** A rectangle is a*** four-sided figure*** or shape and ***all angles should be right angle.***

**__Square__:** A square, there are** *4 sides*** and ***all the four angles are right angles.***

**__Right Angle__*: ***A right angle is ***an angle of exactly 90°***, The angle bounded by*** two lines perpendicular*** to each other.

***A square is a special type of rectangle because it possesses all the properties of a rectangle. Similar to a rectangle, a square has:***

__
 
• Opposite sides that are parallel and equal.
 
• Two diagonals that bisect each other and are equal.

Thus, a*** square*** is a ***rectangle***.

The given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b546f1233cbdc17791cc6081208a176aca1578fa06173351272e9082bffcab.png] 

The rectangles in the figure: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (1, 2)

Hence, **there are 6 rectangles in the figure.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

Squares are a subset of rectangles, hence, all squares are also rectangles.** **

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

I. All keyboards are mouse.

II. Some mouse are printer.

**Conclusion:**

1. No printer is keyboard.

2. Some printers are mouse.

3. All printers are mouse.

4. No keyboards are printer.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram for the given data:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ba21b580fd2cb0f5ccc3289660e7281c21ad3486362b2a08ff7cd5d5a102e12.png] 

Conclusions:

1. No printer is keyboard → it is possible but not definite, hence false.

2. Some printers are mouse → true

3. All printers are mouse → it is possible but not definite, hence false.

4. No keyboards are printer → it is possible but not definite, hence false.

Hence, **only conclusion 2 follows.**

questions.question: Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 5 × 4 + 12 - 3 ÷ 6 = 18
questions.solution:
The given equation: 5 × 4 + 12 - 3 ÷ 6 = 18

On interchanging + and -, we get:

5 × 4 - 12 + 3 ÷ 6 = 18

⇒ 8 + 0.5 = 18 (false)

On interchanging ÷ and ×, we get:

5 ÷ 4 + 12 - 3 × 6 = 18

⇒ 1.25 - 6 = 18 (false)

On interchanging × and +, we get:

5 + 4 × 12 - 3 ÷ 6 = 18

⇒ 5 + 48 - 0.5 = 18 (false)

On interchanging ÷ and -, we get:

5 × 4 + 12 ÷ 3 - 6 = 18

⇒ 20 + 4 - 6 = 18

⇒ 18 = 18

Hence, **we need to interchange ÷ and - to make the situation correct.**

questions.question: In a company there are 3 departments - IT, HR and Help Desk. In the IT department there are 125 employees and in the HR department the number of employees is 1/5th of IT. The helpdesk department has 20 employees less than total employees in IT and HR together. What is the total number of employees working in all three departments?
questions.solution:
Employees in the IT department = 125

Employees in the HR department = 125 ÷ 5 = 25

Employees in the Helpdesk department = 125 + 25 - 20 = 130

Total number of employees in the company = 125 + 25 + 130 = 280

Hence, **there are 280 employees in the company.**
